properties.source: Brihanmumbai Mahanagarpalika (MCGM), Planning Department, "List of existing shelters for urban homeless in the jurisdiction of MCGM" (signed by Assistant Commissioner, Planning; undated on the document itself)
properties.notes: This MCGM document lists 9 facilities; 7 were 'In Operation' with stated capacity (sum = 460), 2 were listed as pending refurbishment/not-yet-operational with no capacity stated. Independent, more recent secondary reporting (Governance Now, 10 Oct 2021, citing a BMC World Homeless Day announcement) describes a different, larger snapshot: 12 adult shelters (capacity 342) + 11 children's shelters (capacity 590) + 2 seasonal monsoon shelters (capacity 930, operate June-October only) = 23 standing shelters, 932 standing capacity. Newslaundry (3 Mar 2021) separately reports 19 BMC-run shelters total (only 10 meeting NULM guidelines) and independently computes Mumbai's NULM-norm requirement at 125 shelters -- this closely corroborates this project's own naive count-norm calculation of ~124-125 shelters from 2011 Census population, done independently. These figures come from different points in time and are not fully reconcilable; none is a full facility-level list except the MCGM document geocoded here.
properties.geocoding_method: OpenStreetMap Nominatim (nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search), cross-checked against data/cities/mumbai/layers/wards.geojson ward centroids (24 administrative wards, WARD property) using shapely for haversine distance sanity-checks.
properties.population_source: Census of India 2011, Greater Mumbai (Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation jurisdiction): 12,442,373
